name: morbidfascination
desc: Gore, death, and viscera don't bother you as much as it does others.

limbskin: Cuts across skin, shaped as rivers are... Hm.
I feel every little movement of my body through the broken flesh of my <limb>...
My <limb> is... kind of pretty, in a strange way.
bleeding: Oh, hello, blood. It's been a minute since we last met.
bleedingheavy: Wonder who all's died because of this... wonder what it feels like. Ah...
miserable: A parasite has crawled in through the gaps of my ribcage and made a nest of my heart. It claws and claws...
selfharm-regulated: Oh, to vivisect myself...! But for now... this will do...
selfharm: So beautiful. It is so beautiful.
angeronitem: Hhhhhello, little friend. Your lobotomy went quite well. How do you feel?
Mmh... Your insides are soft, little friend.
With surgical precision, I tear you limb from limb...
It's only a liiiiittle cut across the throat... Oops. Seems I've hit every possible artery.
...How about that for a tattoo? Haa... cut through every layer of fabric...
I don't do this because I hate you... no, not at all.
Your guts are spilling out... spilling, spilling... Heh...
Mmmh... cutting you open... how does it feel? Does it feel bad? ...No?
Every stitch, undone... every inch, torn...
bleedingresponse: You look good in yellow... UM. Small victories, I mean?

normal: Is it bad to wish for a vivisection? ...Asking for a friend.
Lungs, torn out of the body through... A-ah. Oh, don't mind me. That was... let's not dwell.
